transactions.desc: Burke was promoted to Triple-A Nashville on Sunday, Chase Ford of MiLB Central reports.
Briceno was promoted to Triple-A Toledo on Sunday, per MLB Pipeline.
Workman was optioned to Triple-A El Paso on Sunday.
LaViolette was promoted to Double-A Akron on Sunday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
Kimbrel and the Royals agreed on a major-league contract Sunday, Jon Heyman of the New York Post reports.
Littell agreed to a contract with the Diamondbacks on Sunday, Nick Piecoro of the Arizona Republic reports.
The Cubs reinstated Roberts (forearm) from the 15-day injured list Sunday and optioned him to Triple-A Iowa, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Athletics claimed Rashi off waivers from the Twins on Sunday and optioned him to Triple-A Las Vegas.
The Rays outrighted Wilson to Triple-A Durham on Sunday.
The Rays recalled Grove from Triple-A Durham on Sunday, Ryan Bass of Rays.tv reports.
The Brewers designated Rom for assignment Sunday.
The Brewers signed Bae to a minor-league contract and added him to the 40-man roster and 26-man active roster ahead of Sunday's game against the Twins.
Hays agreed to a one-year contract with the Padres on Sunday, Ken Rosenthal of The Athletic reports.
The Mets selected Weisenburger's contract from Triple-A Syracuse on Sunday.
The Rangers selected Bride's contract from Triple-A Round Rock, and he'll start at third base and bat eighth Sunday against the Orioles.
The Mets optioned Curry to Triple-A Syracuse on Sunday.
The Angels optioned Kerry to Triple-A Salt Lake on Sunday.
The Red Sox selected Martinez's contract from Triple-A Worcester on Sunday, Mac Cerullo of the Boston Herald reports.
The Red Sox optioned Burgos to Triple-A Worcester on Sunday, Mac Cerullo of the Boston Herald reports.
The Phillies optioned Shugart to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Sunday.
The Phillies recalled Rangel from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Sunday.
The Nationals recalled Bird from Triple-A Rochester on Sunday.
Washington optioned Palmquist to Triple-A Rochester on Saturday.
Boston optioned Burgos to Triple-A Worcester after Saturday's matchup with the Athletics, Christopher Smith of MassLive.com reports.
The Rockies reinstated Castano (pectoral) from the injured list Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A Albuquerque.
The Cubs optioned Garrett to Triple-A Iowa on Saturday, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Cubs reinstated Holmes (fibula) from the 60-day injured list ahead of his start Saturday against the Royals, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Mets optioned Wagaman to Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
The Cardinals designated Velazquez for assignment Saturday.
The Rangers optioned Peoples to Triple-A Round Rock on Saturday.
